mods.description: A window of everything your jobs can use now: magic by school, job abilities, weapon skills and pet commands, with costs and recasts; a click uses one; //actions opens it (the action menu add-ons).
mods.name: Action Panel

mods.description: Writes down who is at an event: your party and alliance, and players nearby, with the time, to a file (the linkshell attendance add-ons).
mods.name: Attendance

mods.description: Bids and sales at the auction house by command, and your listings in the log (the auction helper add-ons).
mods.name: Auction Desk

mods.description: Event messages that wait for a key move on by themselves after a few seconds (the text auto-advance add-ons).
mods.name: Text Auto-Advance

mods.description: Saves your automaton's head, frame and attachments as named sets and puts a set on with one command (the automaton set add-ons).
mods.name: Automaton Sets

mods.description: Moves items between your bags by command: fetch and stow by name, gather the gear your Gearshift file names, tidy the rest away (the organizer and porter add-ons).
mods.name: Bag Manager

mods.description: Battle lines in a short form, names coloured by who they are, and others' readies lines hidden (the battle log add-ons).
mods.name: Battle Text

mods.description: Saves your set blue magic as named sets and puts a set back with one command; a codex of every blue spell and what teaches it; a call when a monster readies a move that teaches one you lack (the blue magic add-ons).
mods.name: Blue Magic Sets

mods.description: Works out sums in the chat line or a small window: gil, stacks, prices (the calculator add-ons).
mods.name: Calculator

mods.description: Sets how far the camera stands from you, in and out of battle, and how fast it pans (the camera add-ons).
mods.name: Camera Range

mods.description: Works out a treasure casket's two-digit combination from its hints and tells you what is left and what to try (the casket solver add-ons).
mods.name: Casket Solver

mods.description: A grid of buttons over the party list: a row per member, a column per spell you choose; a click casts it on them (the click-to-cast add-ons).
mods.name: Cast Grid

mods.description: A call sound when you get a tell, someone says your name or a word you chose, invites you or checks you (the chat monitor add-ons).
mods.name: Chat Alerts

mods.description: Hides chat from chosen players, lines with chosen words, shouts or yells, and repeated lines (the chat filter add-ons).
mods.name: Chat Filter

mods.description: A window of its own for a chat channel (tells, party, linkshells, say, shout, yell, unity) with a line to answer in, and a search over the session's lines (the chat window add-ons).
mods.name: Chat Windows

mods.description: Switches for the game's built-in waits and a few display choices (the config and delay add-ons).
mods.name: Client Tweaks

mods.description: Earth time, the moon phase and the next Vana'diel day beside the game's clock (the clock add-ons).
mods.name: Clock

mods.description: What is left to do: the spells a job has yet to learn and every area's quests, done, under way or not started (the checklist add-ons).
mods.name: Completion Log

mods.description: A window for the content you are in: Dynamis, Abyssea, Salvage, Nyzul Isle, Omen, Delve, Odyssey, Sortie or a reive, with the time left and what the content's messages tell; pop lists for the Empyrean and Zeni NMs (the content tracker add-ons).
mods.name: Content Trackers

mods.description: Your own countdowns as rows in the Timers windows, with a line when each is up (the timer add-ons).
mods.name: Countdowns

mods.description: Plays cutscenes and other events faster (the fast-cutscene add-ons).
mods.name: Cutscene Speed

mods.description: NPC talk in a speech bubble with the speaker's face and name, its tail pointing at them, over the speaker or at the bottom of the screen (the balloon add-ons).
mods.name: Dialogue Bubbles

mods.description: /dps: the damage your party dealt since the first hit after a reset; /dps reset starts again.
mods.name: DPS

mods.description: Cancels your status effects by name or id from a command, for macros (the cancel add-ons).
mods.name: Effect Remover

mods.description: Renames characters and monsters on your screen, hides your own name plate, and sets your size (the renamer and name plate add-ons). Only you see it.
mods.name: Entity Styles

mods.description: What you wear as a grid of item icons, as the equipment menu lays it out, with the ammo count (the equipment viewer add-ons).
mods.name: Equipment Grid

mods.description: Runs your command lines when things happen: a zone, a job, an effect gained or lost, HP or MP low, a word in chat, a new day or weather (the auto-exec add-ons).
mods.name: Event Rules

mods.description: The zone lines around you outlined on the ground, so you can see where a zone ends (the zone line add-ons).
mods.name: Exit Markers

mods.description: /find <words>: the bags holding each item whose name has them, the account's other characters' too (the find-all add-ons).
mods.name: Find

mods.description: The modern UI's focus panel on the target panel: the focus target and the last target, each with its HP; a click targets it.
mods.name: Focus and Last Target

mods.description: Your harvesting, logging, mining and excavation this session: tries, success rate, broken tools and what you got (the gathering add-ons).
mods.name: Gathering Log

mods.description: The totals of the stats on everything you wear, from the items' own descriptions and their augments (the gear stat add-ons).
mods.name: Gear Stats

mods.description: Swaps gear around your actions from GearSwap job files and LuAshitacast and Ashitacast XML profiles, unchanged (the gear-swap add-ons).
mods.name: Gearshift

mods.description: Hides chosen parts of the interface in the Mog House, in town zones you name, while fighting or in cutscenes (the hide-the-HUD add-ons).
mods.name: Hide Rules

mods.description: Hotbars of multi-line macros with their actions' icons and recasts, loaded by main job and sub job.
mods.name: Hotbars

mods.description: Bag space, gil and the items and key items you choose, in a window on a screen edge (the inventory and gil tracker add-ons).
mods.name: Inventory HUD

mods.description: A trial weapon's weapon skill points toward its unlock, shown while it is highlighted in a game list and listed by command (the latent checker add-ons).
mods.name: Item Details

mods.description: Charges and counters your jobs use: stratagems, Ready and Quick Draw charges, Ninja shadows and tools, maneuvers (the job gauge add-ons).
mods.name: Job Gauges

mods.description: Binds keys to command lines and makes short aliases for long commands, kept per character (the bind and alias add-ons).
mods.name: Key Commands

mods.description: Numbers the web links in chat so you can open or copy them (the chat link add-ons).
mods.name: Link Catcher

mods.description: Spells, abilities and mounts you never use left out of the game's lists, kept per character (the list trimming add-ons).
mods.name: List Trimmer

mods.description: Writes the chat log to a file a day per character, as plain text (the logger add-ons).
mods.name: Log Files

mods.description: Changes how characters look on your screen only: your race, face and gear, a target's look copied, one race for everyone else (the dress-up add-ons).
mods.name: Look Changer

mods.description: Lots, passes and drops treasure by your lists (the treasury and loot add-ons).
mods.name: Loot Rules

mods.description: Treasure Hunter on your target, what each kind of monster has dropped this session, and the treasure pool's time left (the loot tracker add-ons).
mods.name: Loot Tracker

mods.description: Turns the macro palette to the book and set you keep for each job when the job changes (the macro changer add-ons).
mods.name: Macro Book Switch

mods.description: Notes pinned to places on a zone's map, your party and the monsters you track, marked on the Map Overlay (the map marker add-ons).
mods.name: Map Notes

mods.description: Ctrl or Alt + O shows the zone map over the game (the map add-ons): pan it with a drag, zoom it with the wheel.
mods.name: Map Overlay

mods.description: A small map in a corner that follows you and shows what is nearby (the minimap add-ons).
mods.name: Minimap

mods.description: A box on screen with what nearby monsters ready or start casting, a sound for the moves you watch, and an alert when a monster you watch for comes near (the monster alert add-ons).
mods.name: Monster Alerts

mods.description: A bar across the top of the screen with the zone, the time and weather, and your target: its /check result and the notes you keep on it (the info bar add-ons).
mods.name: Monster Notes

mods.description: Calls a random mount of yours, or one by part of its name (the mount roulette add-ons).
mods.name: Mount Picker

mods.description: Commands, targets and status removal sent to your other game windows on this machine, focus switching, and tells relayed between them (the multibox add-ons).
mods.name: Multibox Control

mods.description: Plays any of the game's tracks, keeps the zone's music in battle or silences it while mounted (the music add-ons).
mods.name: Music Picker

mods.description: Walks an NPC's menus by command, keeps such errands by name, and changes jobs at a moogle by command (the NPC shop and job change add-ons).
mods.name: NPC Errands

mods.description: Saves the Records of Eminence objectives you have set as named sets and puts a set back with one command (the objective set add-ons).
mods.name: Objective Sets

mods.description: Controller crossbars: hold LT or RT and the d-pad and face buttons use that side's eight actions, set per job (the crossbar add-ons).
mods.name: Pad Bars

mods.description: Accepts party invites from the players you list and invites players who send you a chosen word in a tell (the auto-invite and auto-join add-ons).
mods.name: Party Tools

mods.description: The modern UI's chip over the cast bar: the spell, weapon skill, ability or item asked for while the server has not answered, its refusal in the server's words, or that no answer came.
mods.name: Pending Actions

mods.description: Your pet's HP, MP and TP, what it is fighting and your pet commands' recasts, in a window on a screen edge (the pet status add-ons).
mods.name: Pet Status

mods.description: Your HP, MP and TP as large bars near the middle of the screen (the player bar add-ons).
mods.name: Player Bars

mods.description: Type a spell or ability you have as a command, in short: /cure3 me, /provoke, /utsusemiichi (the shortcut add-ons).
mods.name: Quick Commands

mods.description: Plays the character you choose as soon as the character list shows, once per start (the auto-login add-ons).
mods.name: Quick Play

mods.description: Rings on the ground around you at the distances you choose, such as how far your area spells and songs reach (the range display add-ons).
mods.name: Range Rings

mods.description: The Fields or Grounds of Valor regime in force and your kills, in a window beside the timers.
mods.name: Training Regime

mods.description: Says your Corsair roll's number, whether it is lucky or unlucky and its power, and can hold back a Double-Up on a lucky roll (the roll tracker add-ons).
mods.name: Roll Helper

mods.description: Screenshots filed in folders by character and zone, and video recording by command (the screenshot organizer and capture add-ons).
mods.name: Screen Capture

mods.description: Puts your own notes on the screen by command, where you drag them (the text add-ons).
mods.name: Screen Notes

mods.description: Sells items by name to the open shop and hands items to your target NPC by command (the sell and trade add-ons).
mods.name: Sell and Hand In

mods.description: Adds your session's total to each skill-up line, and lists your skills, their caps and today's gains (the skill-up tracker add-ons).
mods.name: Skill-up Log

mods.description: In a party, the skillchains your party can make together; on your target, an open skillchain, what closes it, and when to magic burst (the skillchain add-ons).
mods.name: Skillchain Helper

mods.description: Holds a spell, item or ranged shot you start while moving until you stand still, so moving doesn't interrupt it (castdelay).
mods.name: Steady Cast

mods.description: Rows at the top of the modern battle menu naming a spell, ability or weapon skill worth using now, and why.
mods.name: Battle Suggestions

mods.description: A small bar filling toward your next auto-attack while you fight, from your weapon's delay (the swing timer add-ons).
mods.name: Swing Timer

mods.description: After Synthesize, asks how many to make and crafts them one after another (the crafting add-ons).
mods.name: Synthesis Amount

mods.description: A large HP bar for your target near the top of the screen, with what it is readying or casting (the enemy bar add-ons).
mods.name: Target Bar

mods.description: The effects anyone has put on your target, as icons under the target window (the debuff tracker add-ons).
mods.name: Target Debuffs

mods.description: Your target's distance and HP percent in the target window (the distance and target-info add-ons).
mods.name: Target Info

mods.description: A ring on the ground under your target, in a colour you choose (the target marker add-ons).
mods.name: Target Marker

mods.description: Targets by name or id, turns you toward or away from your target, and can check each monster you target (the targeting add-ons).
mods.name: Targeting Helpers

mods.description: Keeps the tells that come while you are away, answers the last tell with //r, and can send an away reply (the answering machine add-ons).
mods.name: Tell Inbox

mods.description: Recasts, your effects and the ones you put on others and on monsters, in windows that slide in and out (the timers add-ons).
mods.name: Timers

mods.description: The time on every chat log line, not only chat (the timestamp add-ons).
mods.name: Timestamps

mods.description: Tracks a monster or NPC by name with Wide Scan, and lists who in the zone matches a name (the wide scan add-ons).
mods.name: Tracking Tools

mods.description: Saves the trusts you call as named lineups and calls a lineup with one command (the trust set add-ons).
mods.name: Trust Lineups

mods.description: Shows or hides what your trusts say in the chat log (the trust chatter filters).
mods.name: Trust Speech

mods.description: [[words]] in a chat line become the auto-translate phrase, and <tags> such as <star> or <note> become the game's symbols (the translate and chars add-ons).
mods.name: Typing Helpers

mods.description: Uses every copy of an item one after another, such as a stack of pouches or bags (the pouch add-ons).
mods.name: Item Use Queue

mods.description: Changes how the world looks: brightness, colour, a cel-shaded look with outlines, or wireframe (the render tweak add-ons). The menus are not changed.
mods.name: Visual Tweaks

mods.description: Answers the Home Point, Survival Guide and Waypoint menus by name, and warps home with the Warp spell or a warp item (the warp add-ons).
mods.name: Warp Helper

mods.description: Tells you when the weather you are waiting for starts or ends, and can tell your party (the weather add-ons).
mods.name: Weather Watch

mods.description: Looks up an item, a spell, your target or any words on the wiki or the auction site, in your browser (the lookup add-ons).
mods.name: Web Search

mods.description: Puts the game window back where and how big you keep it for each character, and can keep it on top (the window position add-ons).
mods.name: Window Placement

mods.description: Experience, limit and capacity points with their rates per hour, in a window on a screen edge (the point-watch add-ons).
mods.name: XP Tracker

mods.description: The zone's name across the screen for a few seconds as you arrive (the zone name add-ons).
mods.name: Zone Banner
